name: God Being With Us
overview: Scripture assures believers that God is continually present with His people, offering strength, courage, and comfort in every circumstance. From the Old Testament promises in Deuteronomy and Joshua affirming God's unfailing presence and support, to the Psalmist's confidence in God's companionship through life's darkest trials, the Bible reveals a God who strengthens, helps, and upholds His followers. Isaiah emphasizes God's sustaining power and protection, while Zephaniah celebrates God's joyful presence among His people. Finally, Christ's promise in Matthew affirms that God's presence endures perpetually, extending to all who obey His commands until the end of the age.
